name: kube-context-manager
title: Kubernetes Context Manager
description: ⚡ Lightning-fast Kubernetes context switching with advanced search, rich metadata, and comprehensive management. No kubectl required!
author: sebastian_andrei_roman

preferences.name: kubeconfigPath
preferences.title: Kubeconfig Path
preferences.description: Path to the kubeconfig file. Leave empty to use the first entry of $KUBECONFIG or ~/.kube/config.

preferences.name: closeAfterSwitch
preferences.title: Switching
preferences.label: Close Raycast after switching context
preferences.description: Return to the main Raycast window after a successful context switch.

preferences.name: productionPattern
preferences.title: Production Pattern
preferences.description: Case-insensitive regular expression. Matching context names are treated as production and require confirmation before switching.

commands.name: list-contexts
commands.title: Kube Contexts
commands.description: 🔍 Search and switch Kubernetes contexts with advanced filtering and rich metadata

commands.name: current-context
commands.title: Current Context
commands.description: 📍 View current context details with cluster info and quick switching actions

commands.name: switch-context-namespace
commands.title: Switch Context with Namespace
commands.description: 🔄 Two-step workflow: select context, then namespace for efficient switching

commands.name: manage-contexts
commands.title: Manage Contexts
commands.description: 🛠️ Complete context lifecycle management: create, modify, and delete with validation

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
